classification.difficultyReason: Diagnose that Fred compared numerical values in different units, explain why this fails, then convert centimetres to millimetres and simplify.

content.prompt:
Fred incorrectly simplified $12\text{ cm}$ to $3\text{ mm}$ as the ratio $4:1$.

Explain his mistake and what is the correct answer?

answer.short: He did not convert to the same unit. The correct ratio is $40:1$.
answer.worked:
Fred divided the numerical values without first converting to the same unit.

$12\text{ cm}=120\text{ mm}$.

$$\begin{align*}120:3&=(120\div3):(3\div3)\\&=40:1\end{align*}$$
